item.title: Riverland Community College seeks nominations for Alumni Impact Award
item.description: Riverland Community College has announced the creation of the Alumni Impact Award, a recognition program celebrating graduates who are making meaningful contributions in their workplaces, professions or communities.

item.title: ‘Alden is not just a school — it’s a home’
item.description: ALDEN — It’s not uncommon for staff and students who are a part of Alden-Conger School District to see their school community as one of Freeborn County’s best-kept secrets.

item.title: Mobile coffee shop business owners to bring business to established coffee shop location
item.description: LAKE MILLS — Coffee drinkers in Lake Mills have cause for celebration as new business Royce’s Brew is set to open soon.

item.title: Boutique owner thanks family for supporting her goals of owning her own business and giving back to the community
item.description: NORTHWOOD — With its classic black and white exterior design, LuLu & Crew Boutique draws customers in as they peruse downtown Northwood.

item.title: Theft of $2K in electronics and other reports
item.description: Police received a report at 2:59 p.m. Friday of a person who walked out with almost $2,000 of stolen electronics at Walmart, 1550 Blake Ave.

item.title: 'This isn’t over': MN leaders say federal agents still causing chaos, economic disruption statewide
item.description: Minnesota leaders on Friday said they started measuring the financial impact of Operation Metro Surge on the state, even as federal agents still caused daily chaos.

item.title: Irene Marie Nesset
item.description: Irene Marie Nesset passed away on Wednesday, March 4, 2026. Funeral arrangements are pending with Bonnerup Funeral and Cremation Services.

item.title: Alford plea leads to jail, stayed prison time and a long probation in Faribault County child sex abuse case
item.description: A former Wells man was sentenced Monday to just shy of a combined two years in the Faribault County Jail for criminal sexual conduct with a minor he mentored and coached.

item.description: What's happening in the area this week?

item.title: Mayo Health System in Austin expanding its Progressive Care Unit; ICU patients to go to Rochester, Mankato
item.description: Mayo Clinic Health System in Austin has announced the expansion of its Progressive Care Unit for patients in Austin and surrounding communities. Patients who require ICU-level care will be transferred to Mayo hospitals in Mankato or Rochester.
